prompt:
Use the supplied image as a visual reference for composition, subject identity, porcelain material, cobalt decoration and warm ivory lighting. Generate one continuous five-second locked-camera shot of this blue-and-white porcelain teapot. Establish the intended reference-image lighting immediately at the start and maintain it for the entire shot. Preserve the complete teapot silhouette, spout opening, open handle loop, lid seam, round body, foot, landscape relief, miniature pine tree, cobalt decoration, warm ivory background and negative space.

Only the existing delicate steam above the lid knob may move. During the whole interval from 0 to 5 seconds, continuously replenish a small amount of thin, translucent steam from the same fixed origin. As an older wisp rises slowly, gently curls and dissipates, a new faint wisp is already appearing, so a small readable rising plume remains visible at every stage, including seconds 2, 3, 4 and 5. The steam supply does not stop halfway. Do not solve persistence by making a thick smoke cloud: retain fine, pale, restrained wisps, keep the knob readable and confine steam to the small space just above the lid.

The teapot, spout, handle, lid, lid seam, relief mountains, glazed channels, miniature tree and painted patterns stay completely still. No lid lifting, pouring liquid, water running over the relief, rotation, wobble or pattern movement.

Maintain the exact exposure, background luminance, white balance, porcelain highlights and shadows of the reference image from the first frame through the last frame. No opening darkening, auto-exposure settling, fade, relighting, high-light pulsing or color-temperature change. Keep the existing soft light and warm ivory background unchanged.

No camera movement, pan, zoom, cut, transition, deformation or new objects. The result is completely silent: no music, speech, ambient sound or sound effects. Test continuous delicate steam while the porcelain geometry, surface identity and reference-image lighting remain fixed.
visual_observations: 121帧中，四个已确认背景/地面区域的灰度均值范围相对参考图约1.8%–3.6%；本段开场突变比第二轮小。
四个区域的最大参考亮度差异约9.1%–11.8%，超过5%目标。左上区域参考均值230.27，原片首帧211.54，约0.21秒207.39，片尾203.81。
实际送出JSON布尔sound=false，返回文件仍含AAC音轨；解码325632个浮点音频样本均非零，峰值约-32.8dB。未听审具体内容，后台映射仍未知。
覆盖0–5秒的25个时间点中仍可辨认壶盖上方的细蒸汽，后半段与片尾也有细丝；没有形成遮住壶盖的厚重烟团。
检查帧中壶嘴、把手、盖缝和浮雕保持可辨，没有明显开盖、倒水或大幅运镜；单图参考模式不要求与输入图逐像素相同。
method: Unmodified AI original copied byte-for-byte; JPEG derivatives are analysis frames, not generated video replacements
actual_sound_request_note: The supported official omni builder submitted a JSON boolean sound=false. The input image was a visual reference rather than a strict first frame. No undocumented generate_audio gateway field was injected.
review_method: 25 chronological sampled frames, first/end spout/handle/relief crops, first poster, four visually confirmed empty background/ground regions over all121 frames, full codec decode and decoded PCM audio signal count. Audio content not listened to.
verdict: 亮度突变减小了，参考明度与原生无音轨仍未通过。
summary: 单图参考路径下，四个静态区的片内亮度波动约1.8%–3.6%，但从开场就比参考PNG偏暗，最大参考差异约9.1%–11.8%，未达到5%目标。覆盖0–5秒的抽帧中细蒸汽仍可见，壶嘴、把手、盖缝和浮雕基本保持。原片仍有非零音轨，因此不放行山水。
phase_gate_notes: All four tested corners remain comparable empty background or ground in the inspected output; numeric brightness variation passes but target reference brightness error exceeds5%.
The raw clip contains an AAC track and325632 nonzero decoded float samples despite actual JSON boolean sound=false.
Steam and basic object geometry pass the sampled visual checks; these do not compensate for the failed raw brightness/audio gates.
This path changes both conditioning mode and sound JSON type; do not attribute changes to one internal backend cause.
comparison_to_v2: 第二轮首帧附近有较大的明暗下落；本次片内变化更小，但整体从一开始就偏暗，不能把减小跳变当作参考曝光已锁定。两种已测关闭值与路径均未获得无音轨原片。持续供汽与基本壶形在本次样本中保持。
next_revision: 保留目前稳定的第二轮运动基线与已验证本地校正交付。该接入路径的原生曝光/无音轨尚未验证成功；后续需取得网关映射证据或另行评估新接入路径，不自动重试或追加模型费用。
